title: Give a working remedy on the host that removed a task when another host's rebuild returns it
outcome: Give a working remedy on the host that removed a task when another host's rebuild returns it
acceptance: When host A's `task-sync export --rebuild` returns a task that host B removed and retired, B's import names a remedy that the next command accepts, both for the refused return and for every task held or refused because it names the returned task
A two-host CLI test follows B's printed remedies through to a clean import, export and push on both hosts

blockers.detail: Await publication of the w-c39164e2c07b fix on origin/master. Its round-6 held-removal rebuild behavior is the implementation and regression base for this WinB item.
